name: Enjoy ~Futari no Ecchi na Joi to Eroero Kenshuu Taiken~
original_name: 艶女医～2人のエッチな女医とエロエロ研修体験～
source:
The main character is a medical student. He visits a hospital for training, and meets beautiful female doctors and nurses there. Luckily for him, there is no vacant room to stay, so he stays together with two female doctors. His wonderful life with erotic female doctors and nurses starts now!
